check_overrides.G0-03: UC TTS cap selection is deferred; retain attachment/video/reset controls and MaxAI resource controls.
check_overrides.G3-01: UC core excludes TTS and STT.
check_overrides.G3-02: Replace TTS port proof with negative proof that UC TTS is disabled before transport.
check_overrides.G3-04: UC suite includes negative speech route tests only.
check_overrides.G3-06: TTS gate is permanently OFF for this release.
check_overrides.G3-07: Replace TTS decoder tests with zero-transport disabled-route tests; recovered TTS artifacts remain provenance only.
check_overrides.G3-15: No TTS error mapping implementation is required while route is disabled; test disabled fail-close.
check_overrides.G9: No UC TTS/STT request is eligible for a live envelope.

decisions.decision: Keep three boundaries separate: saved native extension layouts 1/2/3/4/6; a distinct recovered host-shim council with a seven-seat parallel=7 outer trace, committed twelve-seat aggregate/real-ChatService driver, and configurable local ceiling 30; and the owner's exact 30/32 episode, whose request-level trace and completion set remain missing. None establishes provider capacity or authorizes concurrency. Do not treat greater-than-six behavior as disproven.

Each future lane must reuse one ordinary single-chat request, private stream accumulator, and hardened provider-exposed reasoning parser. It owns unique run/lane/turn/attempt IDs plus mode-correct conversation/message/parent/tool/cancel/continuation state; provider-returned IDs are recorded only when supplied.
UC TTS and UC STT are excluded from core and live validation because they consume AI credits. Keep disabled/OFF; reopening requires a new explicit owner decision and credit budget.

effect: Project roadmap/acceptance overrides the initial audit planning scope. Forensic audit-source remains unchanged as historical evidence.
